text:
emma: Postmortem follow-up for PM-2026-060 (LB/DNS retry amplification). Root cause summary: partial control-plane race applying legacy route fragments, DNS cache shadowing during flips, and aggressive client-side handshake retries that amplified the surge. Posting owners, short verification steps, and ETA expectations.

ops-bot: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-060 :bookmark_tabs:

raj: I'll take the route-apply race. My plan: add a lightweight revision check before apply (fast path) and a transient throttle when we detect >2 rapid re-applies for the same pool. Mitigation ETA: 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC.

tess: I'll own the DNS invalidation piece. Plan: push a targeted invalidation event on flip and temporarily shorten canary TTLs to 8s. Also emit dns_shadow_events metric. ETA: 2026-06-20 18:30 UTC.

mike: TLS side: region-3 showed spike in concurrent TLS handshakes during cert churn. I'll deploy randomized rotation offsets and a per-edge handshake concurrency cap; add edge_tls_backoff metric. ETA: 2026-06-21 11:00 UTC.

ana: (ana): I'll own monitoring + runbooks. Work: add composite alert that includes spike in edge_tls_backoff, dns_shadow_events, or route_apply_retries; add quick triage checklist. ETA: 2026-06-20 20:00 UTC.

emma: Action list for JIRA (confirm):
- ACTION raj: revision check + transient throttle on re-applies \u2014 ETA 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC
- ACTION tess: targeted invalidation + TTL reduction + metric \u2014 ETA 2026-06-20 18:30 UTC
- ACTION mike: rotation offsets + handshake cap + metric \u2014 ETA 2026-06-21 11:00 UTC
- ACTION ana: composite alert + runbook snippet \u2014 ETA 2026-06-20 20:00 UTC

raj: quick note: throttle will be non-blocking; it only rate-limits repeated applies for the same route id for 60s.

tess: note: invalidation events will be idempotent and include a correlation_id so we can trace which flip caused shadowing.

mike: I'll also add histogram metrics for handshake_latency_by_region so we can correlate handshakes -> retry amplification.

ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled: 2026-06-21 09:00 UTC.

raj: Update 2026-06-20 15:40 UTC: revision-check change merged to canary branch, deploying to canary pools now.

tess: Update 2026-06-20 18:10 UTC: TTL change + invalidation event pushed to canary; dns_shadow_events down ~90% in early telemetry.

mike: Update 2026-06-21 10:15 UTC: rotation offsets rolled to region-3, handshake cap applied; preliminary telemetry shows handshake retries down ~72%. Scheduling full edge rollout at 2026-06-21 14:00 UTC.

ana: Update 2026-06-21 12:00 UTC: composite alerts in place and tested via simulation. Runbook snippet added to PM-2026-060: "If route_apply_retries > 5 in 5m OR dns_shadow_events > 10 in 10m OR edge_tls_backoff_rate increases > 1% => page networking-oncall, attach probe CSV, and consider pausing canary flips."

emma: Verification plan: raj and tess please run the probe matrix after your canary rollouts across us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-south-1. Use this probe:```
curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://lb-probe.local/check -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```
Post CSV to PM-2026-060.

raj: Update 2026-06-20 17:10 UTC: canary route revision-check live; observing reduced reapply count. Will post probe results after tess invalidation finishes.

tess: Update 2026-06-20 19:00 UTC: invalidation + TTL staged. Shadowing metric now stable at baseline. Starting probe sweep.

raj: Update 2026-06-20 20:10 UTC: probe sweep complete. No asymmetric 5xx spikes; p95 latency within normal bounds. Uploaded CSV to PM-2026-060.

mike: Update 2026-06-21 15:10 UTC: full edge rollout complete; global handshake retries down ~70% and back to baseline.

ana: Final: runbook and alerts validated. Moving remaining long-term items (control-plane reconciler rewrite, conntrack tuning, and client-side retry heuristics) to grooming backlog. Closing immediate follow-ups; reopen this thread if regression seen. :white_check_mark:
